Package edu.cnu.mdi.sim.demo.network

Class NetworkModel

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.demo.network.NetworkModel
public final class NetworkModel extends Object
World-coordinate network model for the decluttering demo.

All coordinates are normalized to the unit square:

  • x in [0,1]
  • y in [0,1]

Servers are stored first, followed by clients. Every client connects to exactly one server via an NetworkModel.Edge.

  • Method Details

    • random

      public static NetworkModel random(int serverCount, int clientCount, int printerCount, Random rng)
      Create a random world-based network model in the unit square.

      Servers are placed first, then clients, then printers. Every client is assigned to exactly one randomly chosen server via an NetworkModel.Edge. Each printer is assigned to between 1 and 4 clients (capped at clientCount to prevent an infinite loop when the client pool is very small). All assignments are unique per printer.

      Parameters:
      serverCount - number of servers; must be ≥ 4
      clientCount - number of clients; must be ≥ 6
      printerCount - number of printers; must be ≥ 0
      rng - random number generator; must not be null
      Returns:
      a freshly constructed, randomized NetworkModel
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any count constraint is violated or rng is null
